portal.listingQuotaNote: The Course Admin header shows 'Calendar Listings Available' — a hard cap on how many more classes can be posted. Read it EVERY run before posting and never plan a batch larger than it. As of 2026-08-10: 19 available (25 base + 37 earned).
portal.reconcileAgainstPortal: The portal's My Courses grid is the authority on what already exists. The public Training Finder can lag or omit rows, so a class can exist in the portal without appearing there. Reconcile against the portal before posting or you will create duplicates.

actualRevenue.note: Owner-supplied actuals. NEVER infer a revenue ranking from how often a course runs or from what Deadra calls an anchor — those are delivery-rhythm decisions, not earnings. Ask for fresh numbers rather than guessing.

postingPolicy.blackoutNote: Dates Deadra has told us to keep clear. Nothing posts on these, whatever Supabase carries. Confirm the list each run — it is hers to set, never inferred.
postingPolicy.competitionNote: Score competition on Eastern/New York listings only — that is the bucket Agile36 sells into and the one buyers filter on. A class in another timezone is not competing for the same seat. Set to 'all' to score worldwide.
postingPolicy.anchorRationale: Product Owner/Product Manager stays an anchor regardless of competition — it is the highest-revenue course.
postingPolicy.note: Supabase lists every course on every date (run-what-fills catalog). The partner calendar names a trainer per listing, so we post a credible subset: at most 4 a day, no trainer double-booked.

courseTiers.exclusiveNote: A date carrying one of these runs it ALONE — nothing else is scheduled that day. Deadra: 'Sept 12-13 should be Agile Product Management only.' APM is a multi-day course, so its dates belong to it.

postingPolicy.anchorNote: Anchors run on every cohort day (Mon/Tue, Thu/Fri, Sat/Sun). One floater rotates in to fill the 4th slot. DevOps is excluded — it never draws registrations.

trainers.publicOnlyRule: Only PUBLIC classes count toward the 4-per-day cap and the no-overlap rule. Private classes are invisible to the partner calendar and a trainer may run one alongside a public class — seeing the same trainer twice on a date is fine when one of them is private. Check the class Type before reporting a conflict.
trainers.noOverlapRule: A trainer is occupied for EVERY day their class spans, not just its start date. A 9/16-9/18 class means that trainer takes nothing on 9/16, 9/17, or 9/18. Multi-day courses (Agile Product Management is 3 days) make this bite often — always compare full date ranges, never start dates alone.
trainers.courseRestrictionsNote: Whitelist of who may teach a course; overrides the rotation. Only Deadra and Joe are certified for Lean Portfolio Management — Marcus Ball and Martina Svoboda must never be assigned to it. Ask before assuming any other course is open to everyone.
